# Valheon Command OS — Sovereign Rise of Kingdoms (RoK) Intelligence & Tactical Platform

> Valheon is a full-stack Rise of Kingdoms (RoK) Kingdom Telemetry, KvK Wargaming, Optical Neural Calculator, and Tactical Commander Intelligence Platform—accompanied by Project HERMES, the 1-Click Discord Server & War OS.

## Core Platform Capabilities & Routes

- **Optical Neural Calculators (`/calculators`):** Speedup Calculator, VIP Level & Gem Planner, Equipment Forge & Material Calculator, Action Point (AP) Stash Calculator, Tome / Commander EXP Calculator, and MGE Score Planner—all powered by instant `Ctrl+V` screenshot recognition.
- **Kingdom & KvK Analytics (`/analysis/kingdom`, `/analysis/kvk`, `/analysis/alliances`, `/analysis/players`):** Start-vs-End Delta DKP tracking, multi-dimensional behavioral telemetry, automated deadweight detection, hospital rebound analytics, and Hall of Heroes verified fallen troop overrides.
- **Global Rankings & Seed Matchmaking (`/rankings`, `/tools/matchmaking`, `/tools/migration`):** Imperium / A / B / C / D Seed brackets, Top 300 Kingdom matchmaking power projections, and Migrant Passport calculators.
- **Tactical Commander & Meta Vault (`/guide`):**
  - **Complete Commander & Skill Matrix:** In-game skill multipliers, minimum viable investment benchmarks (`5511`, `5551`, `Max`), skill lock orders, formations (`Arch`, `Wedge`, `Delta`, `Hollow Square`, `Pincer`, `Triple Line`), accessories, and 74-point talent tree distributions.
  - **Stage-Aware Tier Matrices:** Validated pairings for `Season of Conquest (SoC)`, `KvK 2`, `KvK 1`, and `Pre-KvK` across `Open Field`, `Rally`, `Garrison`, `Swarming`, and `Sculpture Investment`.
  - **Multi-March Fleet Lineups:** Synergistic 5, 6, and 7-march open-field and swarming lineups with zero commander overlap.
  - **Sovereign Field Guide Dossiers:** Comprehensive strategic playbooks covering Commanders, Events, KvK Tactics, Equipment Crafting, F2P Farming, and Spending ROI.
  - **Active Redeem Codes:** Verified Rise of Kingdoms gift codes with full reward breakdowns.

## Native 17-Language SSR & HERMES Support

All routes are natively server-rendered with localized URL prefixes (`/en`, `/es`, `/pt`, `/fr`, `/de`, `/it`, `/pl`, `/ru`, `/tr`, `/ar`, `/zh`, `/ja`, `/ko`, `/vi`, `/th`, `/id`, `/ms`).
